name: Feature Restoration
author: neostryder
description:
Brings back beloved Angband features that later versions quietly dropped, as opt-in content. Angband 4.2.6 stays faithful in core - nothing here changes unless you switch a section on.

Each restored feature is its own toggle, so you can take exactly the ones you miss.

sections.title: Restore Teleport Other (Priest, Paladin, Ranger)
sections.description: Older Angband gave every spellcasting class a way to teleport a monster away. Angband 4.2.6 kept it for the Mage and the Rogue and quietly dropped it for everyone else. This adds the same spell - a bolt that teleports the first monster it hits away, farther at higher level - to the Priest, Paladin and Ranger spell lists, each at a level, mana cost and fail rate consistent with their existing books. Nothing about the Mage's or Rogue's own copies is touched.
